items.note: A full-width yellow band with a regular-weight 'Shop all goods' title, an ink rule under it and outline pills ('All' selected in a raised fill) sits over a dense 4-column wall of outlined cards. Each card has a band-color square holding an ink-outlined flat sticker product and a pink price tag, much like the reference's discover page. The count, stock filter and sort sit on one row above an ink rule, gaps are an even 24px, and nothing is clipped.

The header puts the brand and the outlined Cart button with its pink count on one row, with an ink 'Shop' pill below. The band collapses to its title and lead, and the pill strip scrolls ('Accesso…' is cut at the edge, as the spec intends). Filters stack, then one column of full-width sticker cards follows on a steady rhythm with no sideways scroll.

The same layout on black ground. The yellow band keeps ink text, the current 'Shop' pill turns paper-filled, the cards are dark raised boxes with light borders, and the band-color sticker squares and pink price tags read clearly. This follows the spec's dark mapping.

A one-column card stack on black under the collapsed yellow band, with a paper-filled 'Shop' pill, a scrolling pill strip, and stickers on yellow, teal and periwinkle squares. Spacing is even and every label and price is legible.

A breadcrumb sits above a yellow band holding the category and a large regular-weight product title, with an ink rule under it. Below, a two-column layout puts the outlined sticker image frame next to a pink price tag, copy, color choice pills, an outlined quantity stepper and the single pink 'Add to cart' lift button. An ink rule then leads into 'Details'. The price and the one pink action clearly come first.

Breadcrumb, collapsed band and title, then the full-width sticker frame, price tag, copy, Natural/Olive/Charcoal pills, the stepper and the pink Add to cart button, all in one column. Gaps follow the scale, the ink rules separate the blocks, and nothing overflows.

The dark version keeps the yellow band with ink text and the yellow image frame with the outlined tote. The selected 'Natural' pill gets a raised dark fill, the stepper buttons have light borders, and pink stays only on the price tag and Add to cart.

A single column on black: band, sticker frame, pink price tag, color pills with a raised selected fill, the stepper and one pink Add to cart button, then Details. Text contrast is fine and the rhythm matches the light version.

The same detail layout as the tote, with the yellow 'Apparel' band and title, a lime sticker frame with a pink outlined sweater, and S/M/L/XL size pills (S selected with an ink outline). The quantity stepper and the one pink Add to cart lift come next. The structure is consistent with the other detail page.
One column: breadcrumb, collapsed band, sticker frame, price tag, copy, size pills, stepper and pink Add to cart, then the Details list. Spacing is even, and touch targets look at least hit-sized.

On black, the yellow band keeps ink text and the lime frame and pink sweater sticker stay vivid. The selected 'S' pill has a raised fill, and pink appears only on the price and the single Add to cart.
The dark mobile stack mirrors the light one: band, sticker frame, price tag, size pills with a raised 'S', a light-bordered stepper and the pink Add to cart. Nothing is cramped or clipped.

The cart section changes the band to teal ('Your cart' plus the free-shipping line, with an ink rule), and the 'Cart' header pill becomes ink. The centered empty state has one large extruded pink-on-yellow coin sticker, a heading, one sentence and one pink 'Continue shopping' lift button, which matches the spec's empty-state recipe.

The collapsed teal band sits over the centered coin sticker, the 'Your cart is empty' heading, a gray sentence and the pink Continue shopping button. The whitespace is balanced and the footer sits naturally below.

The teal band with ink text sits over black ground. The coin sticker keeps its pink face and yellow rim, the empty-state heading and sentence are light, and the only pink action is Continue shopping. The 'Cart' pill is paper-filled.
The same empty state at phone width in dark: teal band, large coin sticker, heading, sentence and pink Continue shopping button, all centered with even gaps and nothing cut off.
